projects.title: Color Zen
projects.description:
Color Zen is a new kind of puzzle game. With simple, intuitive controls, the game invites you to relax and immerse yourself. There are no points or penalties for failure; just an abstract world of color to move through at your own pace. So put on your headphones and find your way, with Color Zen. Now available on Facebook.
 
My Involvement
- Designed mobile specific features to be web based, social and quickly implementable within our two week development cycle.
- Designed, created and balanced the Color Zen Seasons DLC.

projects.title: AMC's The Ultimate Fan Game
projects.description:
Take quizzes based on your favorite AMC movie or TV Show. Earn badges and challenge your friends. All to figure who is real the Ultimate Fan.﻿
 
My Involvement
- Designed the game to maintain its core elements from the original, while tailoring the old and new features to the theme, 'I want to be the ultimate fan'.
- Adapted to and incorporated client feedback quickly, while minimizing the potential growth in development time through design.
- Created a C# tool that converts the clients original quiz data into a usable format for the company's proprietary software, TOGA.
